olivia: Quick thought: use an index-first bundle plus a tiny proof-stream endpoint so on-prem nodes can verify/apply shards incrementally. Pros: faster warmup, selective fetch. Cons: verifier complexity, signer/epoch edgecases. deepak: Agree. Requirements: signed index with epoch, per-shard merkle roots, streamable leaf proofs, idempotent resume. jane: Operator UX: persist apply_cursor and per-shard verified flag in CRD. Add activation_state (pending|active|failed) and tombstone for aborted attempts. rafael: Security: index must carry signer_id and key_version. Support customer KMS/HSM pubkeys. Consider short-lived activation_token signed by local HSM tying node_id+bundle_id to activation. Reject older epochs. deepak: API sketch: GET /bundles//parts/

/proofs?range=0-1048575 returns newline records of base64(chunk) base64(leaf_proof). Support HTTP Range header. Verifier flow: verify index sig, stream proofs, verify leaves against part merkle root, persist cursor, flip activation when all parts verified. jane: Also add apply_window (default 30m) with exponential retries; on expiry mark failed and revert or require manual recovery. ci-bot: build: artifact-gen now emits compact indices + per-part merkle roots. https://ci.redwood.example/builds/5110 olivia: Next: RFC for index v1 + proof stream, PoC verifier (go/python), CRD fields draft, security doc for signer rotation. I'll start the RFC and tag owners. Thanks! :thumbsup:
